description: Seamless PBR material from a text prompt: albedo (base color), normal, roughness and height maps. Realistic or stylized. Precise layouts (herringbone, chevron, Versailles parquet, basket weave, hexagon tiles...) are drawn exactly so they tile. Asynchronous: returns a generation id; poll get_generation. Spends credits (refunded automatically on failure). Typical time: 120 s.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Same key = same generation, never charged twice. Default: derived from the parameters for 10 minutes; pass a new value to intentionally run the same prompt again.

max_credits.description: Highest price the user accepted (from quote_generation). The call fails with confirmation_required if missing.

model.description: texel-quality = best (1K / 2K / 4K), texel-express = fastest and cheapest (1K only: any other resolution is delivered and charged in 1K), texel-classic = alternative look (1K / 2K / 4K). The 4K is native.

prompt.description: Material description, e.g. "mossy medieval cobblestone, wet".

resolution.description: 4k_native is accepted as 4k (the 4K is native). texel-express always runs in 1K.

save_to_library.description: Optional. When the generation succeeds, publish it in the public 3DTexel community library and add it to the user's library (free). Only if the user asked for it.

name: generate_pbr_material
title: AI PBR Material Generator
